newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle at $68, up $2 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle at $68, up $2 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the Panhandle area early but slow after mid-morning, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were $2.00 per cwt higher.

Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 15,100 slaughter steers and 10,200 heifers; 46,400 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 20,000 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.

Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink. Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 68.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 68.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 66.00. Confirmed - 25,300 Week Ago - None Year Ago - None
Wk to date - 46,400 Week Ago - 23,700 Year Ago - 16,900
